key_insight: The paper accelerates multiscale PDE model reduction by interpolating parameter-dependent local approximation spaces on the Grassmann manifold instead of recomputing them from scratch.
engineering_relevance: This enables efficient surrogate modeling for heterogeneous, parameterized solid mechanics and other multiscale PDE applications with much lower offline cost.
method: Decompose the global multiscale PDE into localized MS-GFEM subproblems with low-dimensional parameter dependence.
Represent each optimal local approximation space as a point on the Grassmann manifold.
Use sparse-grid Grassmann interpolation to approximate local spaces across high-dimensional parameter domains.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments on elliptic problems validate the theory, showing nearly exponential spatial convergence and sparse-grid parametric convergence rates.
watch_item: The approach depends on local parameter dependence and accurate manifold interpolation, so performance may degrade when parameters have strong nonlocal effects or sparse-grid resolution is insufficient.
paper_title: Efficient localised model reduction for multiscale PDEs via Grassmannian interpolation
